## Transferable mechanism summary

(4) Consequence: remotely triggerable kernel heap buffer overflow (OOB write) plus OOB read on the completion/error-unwind path — memory corruption, crash/DoS, potential privilege escalation.     usb: usbip: fix integer overflow in usbip_recv_iso()
    
    usbip_recv_iso() computes the iso descriptor buffer size as:
    
        int size = np * sizeof(*iso);
